claim_text: Before suggesting another vitamin B12 product, reconcile the amount, form, frequency and adherence of existing supplements and fortified foods; an alternative form is not automatically clinically superior.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsupported or duplicate supplementation and support context-specific assessment.

population.other_context: People already taking vitamin B12 supplements and considering another product.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify product label and composition.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Vitamin B12 Health Professional Fact Sheet describes supplemental forms and reliable sources.
limitations: Reported supplement use does not prove adequate status; no additional dose from this claim.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
